# grok-release-radar

> Daily digest app composed by grokhack-forge: collects real GitHub release activity for tracked Grok-integration repos and summarises it with the official xai-sdk (gRPC) using structured output, published to GitHub Pages by Actions.

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/grok-release-radar/main/README.md): overview, install and the 'Use as a building block' section
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/grok-release-radar/main/AGENTS.md): setup, build/test commands, structure map, conventions and rules for AI coding agents
- [blocks.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blockchains/grok-release-radar/main/blocks.json): machine-readable building-block manifest (entrypoints, inputs, outputs, deps, compatible blocks)

## Key files

- [app/collect.py](https://github.com/Blockchains/grok-release-radar/blob/main/app/collect.py): `collect(cfg)`: releases in the window else latest push, via the GitHub API
- [app/summarize.py](https://github.com/Blockchains/grok-release-radar/blob/main/app/summarize.py): `summarize(collected, cfg)`: xai-sdk chat.parse + pydantic
- [app/render.py](https://github.com/Blockchains/grok-release-radar/blob/main/app/render.py): `render()` static site
- [app/main.py](https://github.com/Blockchains/grok-release-radar/blob/main/app/main.py): entry point

## Related

- [Build with Blocks](https://github.com/Blockchains/.github/blob/main/docs/BUILD-WITH-BLOCKS.md): how to assemble projects from Blockchains repos
- [Org llms.txt](https://blockchains.github.io/llms.txt) · [blocks catalogue](https://blockchains.github.io/blocks.json)
- [Blockchains/grokhack-forge](https://github.com/Blockchains/grokhack-forge): the composer that generated it; re-compose for variants
- [Blockchains/grokhack-index](https://github.com/Blockchains/grokhack-index): where its SDK part and reference snippets come from
- [Blockchains/blockchainlab-sdk](https://github.com/Blockchains/blockchainlab-sdk): add blockchain data as tools (chat) or inputs (digest)
